purpose: Frozen measurement protocol and benchmark correctness acceptance, using the existing KNN comparison precedent and the user decision dated 2026-10-13; validation remains to be executed.

package.dependency_pin_basis: Versions supplied from the archived environment. These pins do not establish that every dependency or the runner matches the historical environment.
package.unlisted_dependency_versions: Resolve wheel dependencies, record their exact installed versions and wheel SHA256 hashes; do not claim historical equivalence.

warmup.operation: Fit and transform a separate small model immediately before the measured fit for each dtype, following the supplied historical worker.

process_isolation.dtype_order: Complete float32 calls 1 through 6, then complete float64 calls 1 through 6 in the same worker.
process_isolation.block_boundary: Delete the float32 block arrays and model, then collect garbage before the float64 block; retain interpreter, import and allocator state and record that fact.

output_retention.protocol: Retain the first output, a copy of the first output, and the previous repeated output during each dtype block, matching the supplied historical worker.
output_retention.repeated_output_comparison: Compare every repeated output with the copy of the first output and separately check that the retained original first output still equals that copy.
output_retention.between_call_evidence: Record array layout, non-copying hashes and structural/equality checks outside timers. Descriptive difference calculations are unnecessary for equal repeats. Save call-1 arrays only after the six calls complete. These additional audit checks are explicitly part of this diagnostic protocol.

reference.timing: After both timed Faiss dtype blocks in the same worker, so reference work cannot alter their warm state.
reference.tolerance_status: Criterion source pending. Report numerical differences and identity diagnostics; do not invent a KNN equivalence threshold or declare equivalence from an unsourced threshold.

stage_timings.timing: Separate instrumented replay after both timed Faiss dtype blocks and the KNN reference.
stage_timings.approach: Use supported low-cost train/add/search timing collectors where available; do not instrument the primary timed calls.

run_budget.second_run: Optional only after evaluating the first run and selecting the single strongest hypothesis. It requires a deliberate revised diagnosis; this revision does not implement or trigger it.
run_budget.global_run_count_enforcement: Human-maintained run ledger. Workflow attempt gating and the push token do not prove a global run count.

scaling_plan.measurement_protocol_status: Measurement choices and benchmark correctness criterion frozen; harness implementation and correctness verification remain pending.
scaling_plan.primary_endpoint: fit plus actual first transform; disclose excluded process warmup separately
scaling_plan.warm_reuse_endpoint: Median of calls 2-6 per worker; separate secondary endpoint, never substituted for the primary gate.
scaling_plan.query_size_rule: Fixed 3000 query rows for every training size, including optional 500k.
scaling_plan.workload_value_gate: A dtype-only change does not qualify as a second independent workload. Treat complete_random and available_random as distinct policy/scenario workloads; retain separate dtype series.
scaling_plan.donor_policy_rule: Every measured cell records its series_id, workload_id and explicit donor_policy. Policy stays fixed across size points within a series.

active_development_gate.correctness: Every applicable result must pass benchmark_correctness_criterion and the independent checks. Existing regression tests retain their own tolerances. Failed or unevaluated correctness cannot support a value-gate pass.
active_development_gate.aggregation: Median of matched sklearn/Faiss runtime ratios; publish all seed/repeat evidence and all predefined series, including failures.

resource_budget.wall_time_scope: Full cell wall time including startup, generation, warmup and validation; report performance timing endpoints separately.

optional_500k_gate.missing_or_incomplete_prerequisite: Skip the matching 500k cell as resource_bounded / not_executed.

resource_budget.classification_rule: Budget skips and stops are resource-bounded outcomes, not performance failures. Apply eligibility independently to each matching method/policy/dtype/seed/repeat/environment cell.
resource_budget.paired_comparison_rule: If either method lacks a completed valid result, report the paired speedup as unavailable; do not infer a speedup or a gate pass from a resource stop.

environment_record.secret_handling: Capture only named provenance fields; do not dump the complete environment.

parent_specification.preservation: Keep the v1 and v2 files and diagnosis-1 artifacts unchanged. This revision does not request another ordered-call diagnosis.

diagnosis_decision.outcome: Historical third-call acceleration not reproduced in this environment.
diagnosis_decision.reason: No correctness or measurement-validity issue in this run requires an additional diagnosis.
diagnosis_decision.v1_preservation: Keep the executed v1 specification and artifacts unchanged. This v2 is for the next validation harness, not a request to rerun the v1 diagnostic.

frozen_measurement_protocol.dtype_order_rule: Retain the v1 same-worker dtype order and documented block-boundary state; record any incomplete sequence rather than silently reordering.
frozen_measurement_protocol.small_warmup: For each method and dtype, fit/transform a separate small model using the v1 warmup data definition; record its excluded cost.
frozen_measurement_protocol.primary_endpoint: fit_seconds + actual_call_1_seconds after the disclosed small separate-model warmup
frozen_measurement_protocol.secondary_warm_endpoint: median(transform_call_2_seconds through transform_call_6_seconds) within each worker
frozen_measurement_protocol.primary_summary: Median of nine matched sklearn_primary/Faiss_primary ratios, pairing by workload, series, size, seed and repeat. Display per-seed and individual samples.
frozen_measurement_protocol.secondary_summary: Median of nine ratios of matched within-worker warm medians; retain all individual call times and do not treat five calls as independent workers.
frozen_measurement_protocol.outliers: Retain all samples. Failed or incomplete cells remain explicit; do not delete slow successful samples.
frozen_measurement_protocol.instrumentation: Primary call timings remain uninstrumented. Label available factory/train/add/search observations as separate instrumented replay evidence.
frozen_measurement_protocol.correctness_gate: Apply benchmark_correctness_criterion: rtol=3e-6 and explicit atol=0 for the current k=5 uniform series. Diagnosis 1 exact equality remains evidence only for its measured complete-donor cases; current benchmark validation is pending.

historical_diagnostic_note: The diagnostic section is retained unchanged from v2 as the executed v1 protocol. Its null reference tolerance records the historical state; current benchmark acceptance is defined exclusively in benchmark_correctness_criterion.

benchmark_correctness_criterion.default_rtol_basis: Explicit user decision to adopt the repeated rtol=3e-6 KNN comparison precedent as the benchmark default, including the current k=5 uniform series. No additional source-file search is required.
benchmark_correctness_criterion.project_wide_atol_policy: Not established. Absolute tolerance must be explicit in each benchmark configuration; the existing tests are not a single project-wide atol rule.
benchmark_correctness_criterion.current_uniform_atol_basis: The existing direct uniform-weight KNN comparison specifies rtol=3e-6 and omits atol, giving NumPy testing assert_allclose atol=0. Adopt that relative-only rule for all current uniform series. There is no established absolute numerical error bound in the supplied evidence that justifies adding 3e-6 for these workloads.

scope.interpretation: This is a prospectively frozen benchmark decision based on test precedent. The precedent does not prove that these workloads will pass, and does not establish a universal sklearn-equivalence guarantee.

precedent.scope_note: This test supplies the relative-tolerance precedent; its absolute allowance is not transferred to uniform benchmarks.

precedent.atol_source: numpy.testing.assert_allclose default; omitted in the existing test
precedent.input_dtype: integer arrays; no explicit output dtype assertion
precedent.scope_note: This is a direct uniform KNN comparison and the basis for selecting atol=0. It is not a float32/float64 parameterized benchmark.

numerical_acceptance.rule: For every originally missing query cell: abs(faiss_value - knn_value) <= atol + rtol * abs(knn_value). All cells must pass.
numerical_acceptance.comparison_arithmetic: Evaluate errors and tolerance bounds in float64 after imputation in the configured original dtype; do not rerun or change imputation dtype for acceptance.
numerical_acceptance.scope_of_values: Compare the same query cells from the same prepared inputs. Preserve observed query values exactly as a separate requirement; do not replace the elementwise rule with a bound based on a global maximum, mean, RMSE, or MAE.
numerical_acceptance.zero_reference: Requires numerical equality because atol=0; signed zero is not a failure.
numerical_acceptance.near_zero_reference: A small absolute discrepancy may fail the relative-only rule, including through cancellation. Report it explicitly; do not introduce a floor, exclude near-zero cells, or change atol after seeing outcomes.
numerical_acceptance.aggregation: Every prescribed seed/repeat/call result must satisfy the rule. Do not average away failures or select only passing subsets.

independent_checks: Expected shape and configured output dtype.
Finite outputs and exact preservation of observed query values.
Training and query inputs remain unchanged.
Actual calls 2-6 equal call 1, and the retained original first output remains unchanged, under the frozen measurement protocol.
required_result_evidence: workload_id, series_id, donor_policy, weights, n_neighbors, dtype, seed and repeat
rtol, atol, reference method and comparison arithmetic
compared cell count and tolerance violation count
maximum absolute difference, zero-reference violation count, and worst violating cell with actual value, reference value and allowed error
individual structural and repeat-consistency check outcomes
passed, failed or not_evaluated status with reason
benchmark_correctness_criterion.failure_handling: Any tolerance or independent-check failure makes the cell ineligible to support the correctness/value gate. Retain timings and discrepancies as descriptive evidence. A KNN acceptance failure is not by itself proof that FaissImputer is mathematically wrong.
benchmark_correctness_criterion.incomplete_handling: Missing or incomplete evidence is not_evaluated, never a pass. A resource-budget stop remains resource_bounded rather than a performance failure, as specified in scaling_plan.resource_budget.

change_control.forbidden: Do not increase rtol/atol, drop failing cells, swap the reference operand, or switch to a different error metric to make observed results pass.
change_control.other_configurations: Use default rtol=3e-6. Before evaluating another configuration, explicitly state its atol and justification from existing tests and a numerical error rationale; do not silently inherit the weighted-test 3e-6 absolute allowance or this uniform-only absolute decision.
change_control.existing_tests: Leave the existing regression-test tolerances unchanged.
